facts.fact: StackAdapt was ranked No. 53 on the Report on Business list of Canada's Top Growing Companies in 2022.
facts.quote: StackAdapt has been ranked No. 53 on the Report on Business list of Canada’s Top Growing Companies.

facts.fact: A total of 430 companies earned a spot on the 2022 Canada's Top Growing Companies ranking.
facts.quote: In total, 430 companies earned a spot on this year’s ranking.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's ranking in the 2022 Top Growing Companies program was based on revenue growth of 870%, per the company's press release.
facts.quote: In 2022, StackAdapt’s ranking is based on revenue growth of 870%.

facts.fact: The Top Growing Companies program ranks businesses by percentage revenue growth over three years and was launched in 2019 by The Globe and Mail.
facts.quote: ranks qualifying independent Canadian businesses based on the percentage of their revenue growth over the course of three years.

facts.fact: To qualify for the 2022 Top Growing Companies ranking, a company had to have at least $2 million in annual sales in its most recent fiscal year.
facts.quote: a company had to have at least $2 million in annual sales in its most recent fiscal year.

facts.fact: StackAdapt has ranked as a Top Growing Company for four consecutive years, according to the press release.
facts.quote: For four consecutive years, StackAdapt has ranked as a Top Growing Company.

facts.fact: For the 2022 ranking, growth rates were calculated from fiscal 2021 and 2018 revenues, or in some cases fiscal 2022 and 2019 revenues.
facts.quote: growth rates were calculated from the fiscal 2021 and 2018 revenues of participating companies. Or, in some instances, fiscal 2022 and 2019.

facts.fact: The Globe and Mail's Report on Business magazine reaches 2 million readers in print and digital every issue, per The Globe and Mail's own boilerplate.
facts.quote: Report on Business magazine reaches 2 million readers in print and digital every issue.

facts.fact: The Globe and Mail newspaper reaches 6.4 million readers every week in print or digital formats, per The Globe and Mail's own boilerplate.
facts.quote: The Globe and Mail newspaper reaches 6.4 million readers every week in print or digital formats
